      "claim": "The problem of the relation between the artificial and the natural in The Human Condition is fit into a double narrative consisting of cultural criticism and political philosophy, with cultural criticism being the stronger narrative.",

      "supporting_excerpt": "The problem of the relation for artificial and natural has been fit into a double narra - tive in The Human Condition ; it partly belongs to the narrative of cultural criticism, partly belongs to that of political philosophy.     {
      "claim": "In the closing chapter of The Human Condition, Arendt returns to the narrative of cultural criticism, where re-naturalization and the fading out of action represent the main threat of modernity rather than environmental pollution.",
      "claim_type": "author_position",
      "supporting_excerpt": "However, in the closing chapter, Arendt returns back to the narrative of cultural criticism, albeit giving a special meaning to the notions of natural and artificial.
